arabic_text: إِنَّمَا الْأَعْمَالُ بِالنِّيَّاتِ وَإِنَّمَا لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مَا نَوَى
english_text: Actions are judged by intentions, and every person will get what they intended.

arabic_text: بُنِيَ الْإِسْلَامُ عَلَى خَمْسٍ شَهَادَةِ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ وَإِقَامِ الصَّلَاةِ وَإِيتَاءِ الزَّكَاةِ وَالْحَجِّ وَصَوْمِ رَمَضَانَ
english_text: Islam is built on five pillars: the testimony that there is no god but Allah and Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, establishing prayer, paying zakat, performing Hajj, and fasting in Ramadan.

arabic_text: لَا يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى يُحِبَّ لِأَخِيهِ مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ
english_text: None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.

arabic_text: خَيْرُكُمْ مَنْ تَعَلَّمَ الْقُرْآنَ وَعَلَّمَهُ
english_text: The best among you are those who learn the Quran and teach it.

arabic_text: مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا أَوْ لِيَصْمُتْ
english_text: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him speak good or remain silent.

arabic_text: لَيْسَ الشَّدِيدُ بِالصُّرَعَةِ إِنَّمَا الشَّدِيدُ الَّذِي يَمْلِكُ نَفْسَهُ عِنْدَ الْغَضَبِ
english_text: The strong person is not the one who can wrestle others, but the one who controls himself at the time of anger.

arabic_text: يَسِّرُوا وَلَا تُعَسِّرُوا وَبَشِّرُوا وَلَا تُنَفِّرُوا
english_text: Make things easy and do not make them difficult. Give good tidings and do not drive people away.

arabic_text: مِنْ حُسْنِ إِسْلَامِ الْمَرْءِ تَرْكُهُ مَا لَا يَعْنِيهِ
english_text: Part of the perfection of a person's Islam is leaving that which does not concern him.

arabic_text: الدُّنْيَا سِجْنُ الْمُؤْمِنِ وَجَنَّةُ الْكَافِرِ
english_text: The world is a prison for the believer and a paradise for the disbeliever.

arabic_text: الطُّهُورُ شَطْرُ الْإِيمَانِ
english_text: Purity is half of faith.

arabic_text: الْمُسْلِمُ مَنْ سَلِمَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ مِنْ لِسَانِهِ وَيَدِهِ
english_text: A Muslim is one from whose tongue and hand other Muslims are safe.

arabic_text: مَنْ غَشَّنَا فَلَيْسَ مِنَّا
english_text: Whoever cheats us is not one of us.

arabic_text: لَا يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ مَنْ كَانَ فِي قَلْبِهِ مِثْقَالُ ذَرَّةٍ مِنْ كِبْرٍ
english_text: No one who has an atom's weight of arrogance in his heart will enter Paradise.

arabic_text: الدِّينُ النَّصِيحَةُ
english_text: The religion is sincere advice.

arabic_text: مَنْ سَلَكَ طَرِيقًا يَلْتَمِسُ فِيهِ عِلْمًا سَهَّلَ اللَّهُ لَهُ طَرِيقًا إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ
english_text: Whoever takes a path seeking knowledge, Allah will make easy for him a path to Paradise.

arabic_text: تَبَسُّمُكَ فِي وَجْهِ أَخِيكَ لَكَ صَدَقَةٌ
english_text: Your smiling in the face of your brother is charity.

arabic_text: لَا ضَرَرَ وَلَا ضِرَارَ
english_text: There should be no harm and no reciprocal harm.

arabic_text: إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يَنْظُرُ إِلَى صُوَرِكُمْ وَأَمْوَالِكُمْ وَلَكِنْ يَنْظُرُ إِلَى قُلُوبِكُمْ وَأَعْمَالِكُمْ
english_text: Allah does not look at your appearances or wealth, but He looks at your hearts and deeds.

arabic_text: الْمُؤْمِنُ لِلْمُؤْمِنِ كَالْبُنْيَانِ يَشُدُّ بَعْضُهُ بَعْضًا
english_text: The believer to another believer is like a building whose parts reinforce each other.

arabic_text: خَيْرُ النَّاسِ أَنْفَعُهُمْ لِلنَّاسِ
english_text: The best of people are those who are most beneficial to people.

arabic_text: مَنْ لَا يَرْحَمُ لَا يُرْحَمُ
english_text: He who does not show mercy will not be shown mercy.

arabic_text: اتَّقِ اللَّهَ حَيْثُمَا كُنْتَ وَأَتْبِعِ السَّيِّئَةَ الْحَسَنَةَ تَمْحُهَا وَخَالِقِ النَّاسَ بِخُلُقٍ حَسَنٍ
english_text: Fear Allah wherever you are, follow a bad deed with a good deed and it will erase it, and treat people with good character.

arabic_text: إِنَّمَا بُعِثْتُ لِأُتَمِّمَ صَالِحَ الْأَخْلَاقِ
english_text: I was only sent to perfect good character.

arabic_text: الْجَنَّةُ تَحْتَ أَقْدَامِ الْأُمَّهَاتِ
english_text: Paradise is beneath the feet of mothers.

arabic_text: الْحَيَاءُ مِنَ الْإِيمَانِ
english_text: Modesty is a branch of faith.

arabic_text: الدُّعَاءُ هُوَ الْعِبَادَةُ
english_text: Supplication is the essence of worship.

arabic_text: مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيَّ صَلَاةً صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ بِهَا عَشْرًا
english_text: Whoever sends blessings upon me once, Allah will send blessings upon him tenfold.

arabic_text: أَحَبُّ الْأَعْمَالِ إِلَى اللَّهِ أَدْوَمُهَا وَإِنْ قَلَّ
english_text: The most beloved deeds to Allah are those done consistently, even if they are small.

arabic_text: كُلُّ مَعْرُوفٍ صَدَقَةٌ
english_text: Every act of goodness is charity.

arabic_text: إِذَا مَاتَ الْإِنْسَانُ انْقَطَعَ عَنْهُ عَمَلُهُ إِلَّا مِنْ ثَلَاثَةٍ إِلَّا مِنْ صَدَقَةٍ جَارِيَةٍ أَوْ عِلْمٍ يُنْتَفَعُ بِهِ أَوْ وَلَدٍ صَالِحٍ يَدْعُو لَهُ
english_text: When a person dies, his deeds come to an end except for three: ongoing charity, beneficial knowledge, or a righteous child who prays for him.

arabic_text: لَا تَغْضَبْ
english_text: Do not become angry.

arabic_text: الْمُسْلِمُ أَخُو الْمُسْلِمِ لَا يَظْلِمُهُ وَلَا يُسْلِمُهُ
english_text: A Muslim is the brother of another Muslim. He does not wrong him or hand him over to harm.

arabic_text: أَكْمَلُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ إِيمَانًا أَحْسَنُهُمْ خُلُقًا
english_text: The most complete of believers in faith are those with the best character.

arabic_text: مَا مَلَأَ آدَمِيٌّ وِعَاءً شَرًّا مِنْ بَطْنٍ
english_text: No human has filled a vessel worse than his stomach.

arabic_text: مَثَلُ الْجَلِيسِ الصَّالِحِ وَالْجَلِيسِ السَّوْءِ كَحَامِلِ الْمِسْكِ وَنَافِخِ الْكِيرِ
english_text: The example of a good companion and a bad companion is like that of a musk seller and a blacksmith's bellows.

arabic_text: مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ فَلْيُكْرِمْ ضَيْفَهُ
english_text: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him honor his guest.

arabic_text: لَا يَشْكُرُ اللَّهَ مَنْ لَا يَشْكُرُ النَّاسَ
english_text: He who does not thank people does not thank Allah.

arabic_text: الصَّلَوَاتُ الْخَمْسُ وَالْجُمُعَةُ إِلَى الْجُمُعَةِ وَرَمَضَانُ إِلَى رَمَضَانَ مُكَفِّرَاتٌ مَا بَيْنَهُنَّ إِذَا اجْتُنِبَتِ الْكَبَائِرُ
english_text: The five daily prayers, Friday to Friday, and Ramadan to Ramadan are expiation for sins between them, as long as major sins are avoided.

arabic_text: أَفْضَلُ الْجِهَادِ كَلِمَةُ حَقٍّ عِنْدَ سُلْطَانٍ جَائِرٍ
english_text: The best form of striving is a word of truth before a tyrannical ruler.

arabic_text: إِنَّ اللَّهَ رَفِيقٌ يُحِبُّ الرِّفْقَ فِي الْأَمْرِ كُلِّهِ
english_text: Indeed, Allah is gentle and loves gentleness in all matters.

arabic_text: مَا نَقَصَتْ صَدَقَةٌ مِنْ مَالٍ
english_text: Charity does not decrease wealth.

arabic_text: كُلُّكُمْ رَاعٍ وَكُلُّكُمْ مَسْئُولٌ عَنْ رَعِيَّتِهِ
english_text: Each of you is a shepherd and each of you is responsible for his flock.

arabic_text: إِنَّ مِنْ أَحَبِّكُمْ إِلَيَّ وَأَقْرَبِكُمْ مِنِّي مَجْلِسًا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ أَحَاسِنَكُمْ أَخْلَاقًا
english_text: The dearest and closest of you to me on the Day of Judgment will be those with the best character.

arabic_text: مَنْ كَظَمَ غَيْظًا وَهُوَ قَادِرٌ عَلَى أَنْ يُنْفِذَهُ دَعَاهُ اللَّهُ عَلَى رُءُوسِ الْخَلَائِقِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ
english_text: Whoever suppresses his anger when he is able to act upon it, Allah will call him before all creation on the Day of Resurrection.

arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ
english_text: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from worry and grief, from weakness and laziness.

arabic_text: الْحَلَالُ بَيِّنٌ وَالْحَرَامُ بَيِّنٌ وَبَيْنَهُمَا أُمُورٌ مُشْتَبِهَاتٌ
english_text: The halal is clear and the haram is clear, and between them are doubtful matters.

arabic_text: مَنْ قَامَ رَمَضَانَ إِيمَانًا وَاحْتِسَابًا غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ
english_text: Whoever stands in prayer during Ramadan out of faith and seeking reward, his previous sins will be forgiven.

arabic_text: خَيْرُكُمْ خَيْرُكُمْ لِأَهْلِهِ وَأَنَا خَيْرُكُمْ لِأَهْلِي
english_text: The best of you are those who are best to their families, and I am the best of you to my family.

arabic_text: إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَتَبَ الْإِحْسَانَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ
english_text: Indeed, Allah has prescribed excellence in all things.

arabic_text: الْكَلِمَةُ الطَّيِّبَةُ صَدَقَةٌ
english_text: A good word is charity.
